items.text: Final report: Indianapolis ruled out CB Sauce Gardner (calf), TE Tyler Warren (groin) and WR Anthony Gould (concussion); LB CJ Allen (ankle) is questionable per CBS (Yahoo lists him out), with LB Bryce Boettcher, CB Justin Walley and P Rigoberto Sanchez also questionable. WR Alec Pierce is on IR.
Final report: Minnesota lists only RB Jordan Mason (thumb) as questionable; Justin Jefferson and Kyler Murray have no designation.

adjust.reason: Indianapolis is without CB Sauce Gardner and TE Tyler Warren (WR Alec Pierce already on IR) while Minnesota is essentially healthy. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
